title: Raw Bedrock Ore
description: The first step to processing &eRaw Bedrock Ore&r straight out of the ground is to run it through a &3Bedrock Ore Processor&r. This will split the raw ore into general types, with amounts depending on the location the ore was extracted and any effectiveness upgrades. These types are:
&eRare Earth&r - rare earth metals including &6Cobalt/Rare Earth&r
